shellCommands.command: git diff package.json; cat package.json; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | head -50; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
for f in next.config.ts lib/products.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx "app/products/[slug]/page.tsx" tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
for u in "/products/lamp?currency=EUR" "/products/lamp" "/products/vase?currency=EUR" "/products/nope"; do echo "== $u"; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w "%{http_code} %{time_starttransfer}s first byte, %{time_total}s total\n" "http://localhost:3123$u"; grep -oE "(Signal Shop collection|Loading[^<]*|Brass lamp|Stone vase|(USD|EUR) [0-9.]+|could not be found)" /tmp/out.html | sort | uniq -c; done
pkill -f "next start"; true

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
for u in "/products/lamp?currency=EUR" "/products/lamp" "/products/vase?currency=EUR" "/products/nope"; do echo "== $u"; curl -s -o /tmp/out.html -w "status %{http_code}, first byte %{time_starttransfer}s, total %{time_total}s\n" "http://localhost:3123$u"; for s in '>Signal Shop collection<' '>Loading product…<' '>Loading related products…<' '>Brass lamp<' '>Stone vase<' '>EUR 110.40<' '>USD 120.00<' '>EUR 73.60<' 'This page could not be found' 'noindex'; do printf "  %-32s %s\n" "$s" "$(grep -c -- "$s" /tmp/out.html)"; done; done
echo "== repeat (cached details)"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "total %{time_total}s\n" "http://localhost:3123/products/lamp?currency=EUR"
pkill -f "next start" >/dev/null 2>&1; cat /tmp/next.log | tail -5

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
curl -s "http://localhost:3123/products/nope" | sed 's/<script[^>]*>[^<]*<\/script>//g' | grep -oE '<(h1|h2|p|template|meta)[^>]*>[^<]*' | head -30
pkill -f "next start" >/dev/null 2>&1; true
